en_title: How GTA 6 Came Together at Rockstar North
opus_summary: Rockstar North联合工作室负责人Rob Nelson谈到《GTA6》的开发，称长期坚持和团队协作至关重要。他表示，游戏团队规模是《RDR 2》开发时的两倍；若在当前硬件上追求60帧，游戏将不得不作出过多妥协。

paragraphs.en: Current Rockstar North Co-Studio Head and Head of Development Rob Nelson seems relaxed for a man in Rockstar North’s bridge, essentially moments from steering what may well be the most anticipated entertainment product launch of all time into port — after 13 long years, no less.
paragraphs.cn: 现任Rockstar North联合工作室负责人兼开发主管Rob Nelson看上去很放松。对于一个身处Rockstar North指挥台、即将把或许是有史以来最受期待的娱乐产品发布引领进港的人来说，他显得很轻松——更何况，这已经历了漫长的13年。

paragraphs.en: What’s perhaps more interesting, however, is how even Nelson is quite happy to concede that not even he quite knows how a game as fundamentally huge and absolutely astonishing as GTA 6 has come together so magically. Money and talent is only a part of the answer; the rest is perhaps a little more nebulous.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，或许更有意思的是，就连Nelson也很乐意承认，像《GTA6》这样规模极其庞大、令人叹为观止的游戏，是如何如此神奇地制作完成的，就连他自己也不太清楚。资金和人才只是答案的一部分；其余部分或许要更加难以捉摸。

paragraphs.en: “I think it takes a lot of obstinance, really,” explains Nelson. “Just a sort of stubborn persistence in pursuit of the same thing for a long time, and a team that’s been together for a really long time. Now a really, really long time.
paragraphs.cn: 「我觉得这真的需要很强的执拗劲，」Nelson解释道。「就是长期执着地追求同一件事，以及一支已经共事了很久的团队。现在已经是非常、非常久了。

paragraphs.en: “And the answer is I don’t know. I mean, I only know my part of it, which is a part of it. And the stuff that [co-studio head] Aaron [Garbutt] does, and the stuff that [director of technology] Phil [Hooker] does, and the stuff that the programming team does, I don’t know. They just do it and we sort of build it up in layers.”
paragraphs.cn: 「而答案是我不知道。我的意思是，我只了解自己负责的部分，那只是其中一部分。至于［联合工作室负责人］Aaron［Garbutt］做的事、［技术总监］Phil［Hooker］做的事，以及编程团队做的事，我都不了解。他们就那样把事情做好，而我们则一层一层地把它构建起来。」

paragraphs.en: Nelson explains that Hooker sent an update through to the team very recently that showcased the progress of missions, areas, and features in the game over the last few years, and says it was “shocking to see how far it’s come.”
paragraphs.cn: Nelson解释说，Hooker最近向团队发送了一份更新，展示了游戏中的任务、区域和功能在过去几年里的进展。他说，「看到它取得了如此大的进展，令人震惊」。

paragraphs.en: “Well, unfortunately, lots of people saw it in the hack that we had a few years ago — where [the game] was,” he says. “And I think in development you forget that. You forget the doldrums that you go through and you just sort of cling on to little wins every day, day by day or week by week. Sometimes they feel few and far between — certainly when you’re a few years out. And it’s just trust in the people that you’ve worked with for a long time that they’re going to hold up their end of it.”
paragraphs.cn: 「嗯，不幸的是，几年前我们遭遇黑客攻击时，很多人都看到了［游戏］当时的样子，」他说。「我觉得在开发过程中，你会忘记这一点。你会忘记自己经历过的低迷时期，只是一天天或一周周地紧抓着每天的小小成果。有时候这些成果似乎很少出现、相隔很久——尤其是在距离完成还有好几年的时候。而这完全是靠着对共事多年的人的信任，相信他们会做好自己那部分工作。」

paragraphs.en: “And this game had to rely on that. It probably sounds like a cliché answer, but this team and this game needed that more than we’ve ever had, because we’re larger than we’ve ever been — double the size that we were on RDR 2 — more spread out than we’ve ever been in terms of studios all over the world. Time zones. COVID.
paragraphs.cn: 「而这款游戏必须依靠这种信任。这听起来可能是个老生常谈的回答，但这个团队和这款游戏比我们以往任何时候都更需要这种信任，因为我们的规模比以往任何时候都大——是开发《RDR 2》时的两倍——分布在世界各地的工作室也比以往任何时候都更加分散。还有时区。新冠疫情。

paragraphs.en: “And you sit in it for week after week and just go, ‘Is this thing ever going to come together? Are we ever going to find it?’ But I think because we’ve been pursuing the same thing for a long time, every team knows what they generally want to do and want to evolve, and they just get on with it. And we work in these sort of eight-week sprints and pull a bunch of stuff together, evaluate it, make a bunch of notes, go back, iterate, iterate, iterate.”
paragraphs.cn: 「你一周又一周地待在其中，不禁会问：『这东西到底能不能做成？我们到底能不能找到方向？』但我认为，因为我们一直在追求同一件事，每个团队大体上都知道自己想做什么、想改进什么，然后他们就着手去做。我们的工作方式有点像以八周为一个冲刺周期，把一堆东西整合起来，进行评估，记下许多意见，然后回去不断迭代、迭代、再迭代。」

paragraphs.en: Teams getting on with it appears to be precisely how fantastic and unexpected flourishes make their way to the final product. I note an example, which is the fact that there's now a unique animation solution for characters to get out of cars in skinny gaps, when the door can’t open all the way. Nelson lights up.
paragraphs.cn: 团队着手去做，似乎正是那些精彩而出人意料的细节进入最终产品的方式。我举了一个例子：现在，当车门无法完全打开时，角色在狭窄间隙中下车有了一套独特的动画方案。Nelson听后神情一亮。

paragraphs.en: “There’s so many examples of it across the game, but that is a great example of one where the team just does their thing,” he says. “That hit a build one day and I played it just like you played it. And I was, like, ‘Holy shit, look at this. It’s amazing.’ I never asked for it. As far as I know, none of the other heads of development asked for it. The team did it. The animation directors decided that they wanted to do it.
paragraphs.cn: 「整个游戏里有很多这样的例子，但这个很好地说明了团队是如何自行发挥的，」他说。「有一天那个东西出现在一个版本里，我就像你体验它一样体验到了它。我当时心想：『我的天，看这个。太棒了。』我从没要求做这个。据我所知，其他开发主管也没有要求过。这是团队做的。动画总监们决定要做这件事。

paragraphs.en: “And that’s the most exciting thing, I think, for this team working on this stuff. It’s that there’s so many talented and experienced people working on it, and caring equally about their part, that every build is exciting. That’s I think what sustains you. It’s like every time you get a new build and there’s new stuff hitting it. It gives you energy to keep going.
paragraphs.cn: 「我觉得，对于这个从事这些工作的团队来说，那是最令人兴奋的事。有那么多才华横溢、经验丰富的人在参与制作，而且都同样关心自己负责的部分，因此每个版本都令人兴奋。我觉得那就是支撑你坚持下去的东西。就像每次拿到新版本时，都会有新东西加入进来。这会给你继续前进的动力。

paragraphs.en: “And it can be anything. It could be new ads on the radio, or just the radio going live for the first time. It can be new UI elements coming in to try, or little touches like that and you go, ‘Okay, all right, we’re just going to keep going.’ But, yeah, that’s a great example of something that just the team did off their own back.”
paragraphs.cn: 「而且什么都可能成为这样的东西。可能是电台里的新广告，也可能只是电台第一次开始播放。可能是加入了可以尝试的新UI元素，或是那样的小细节，然后你会说：『好吧，好吧，我们就继续做下去。』不过，没错，那是团队自行完成某件事的一个很好的例子。」

paragraphs.en: Nelson concedes that this approach does have to be managed, because without any guardrails, “every team will go crazy and go on forever.”
paragraphs.cn: Nelson承认，这种做法确实需要管理，因为如果没有任何限制，「每个团队都会疯狂地没完没了地做下去」。

paragraphs.en: “And so there’s a bit of a contract there between all of us, including ourselves; having checks and balances in terms of where we push, how far we push, how hard we push, and how much resource [something] is worth, because everything is time and resource spent,” he says. “And contrary to what people think, we don’t have infinite money or time, or resource. So we do have to make decisions.”
paragraphs.cn: 「所以我们所有人之间，包括我们自己在内，有一种默契；在我们要在哪些方面投入、投入到什么程度、付出多大努力，以及［某件事］值得投入多少资源这些问题上，要有制衡机制，因为做任何事情都要花费时间和资源，」他说。「而且与人们想的不一样，我们没有无限的资金、时间或资源。所以我们确实必须做出取舍。」

paragraphs.en: On the topic of decisions, Rockstar’s confirmation that GTA 6 runs at 30 frames per second across all platforms including PS5 Pro became a popular talking point last week. Speaking with Nelson about what would have to fundamentally change about GTA 6 – and when – if the game had targeted 60fps, the Rockstar North veteran has a very simple answer.
paragraphs.cn: 说到取舍，Rockstar确认《GTA6》在包括PS5 Pro在内的所有平台上都以每秒30帧运行，这在上周成为了热门话题。谈到如果游戏以60fps为目标，《GTA6》在根本上需要做出哪些改变，以及何时需要改变，这位Rockstar North老将给出了一个非常简单的回答。

paragraphs.en: “Too much, too much,” he says “It wouldn’t have been acceptable to anybody. The simple answer is, when you ask the technical team, they’re, like, ‘Have you seen it?’ There’s too many compromises that would’ve had to have been made to do that, is the short answer.”
paragraphs.cn: 「太多了，太多了，」他说。「那是谁都无法接受的。简单来说，当你问技术团队时，他们会说：『你看过它吗？』简而言之，要做到那一点就必须做出太多妥协。」

paragraphs.en: In simple terms, the frame rate had to be limited somewhere in order to achieve Rockstar’s artistic vision. While the team is not ruling out things being different on future hardware, GTA 6’s sheer amount of visual fidelity, the complexity of its simulation, and the amount of systems and gameplay options it has would simply not be possible on current hardware at higher frame rate.
paragraphs.cn: 简单来说，为了实现Rockstar的艺术愿景，帧率必须限制在某个水平。虽然团队并未排除未来的硬件上情况会有所不同，但《GTA6》极高的视觉保真度、模拟的复杂性，以及它所拥有的大量系统和玩法选项，根本不可能在当前硬件上以更高帧率实现。

paragraphs.en: After playing it for the last three weeks I can’t imagine removing anything. Interestingly, it appears Nelson plays GTA 6 in an extremely similar way to the style of play I settled into during the review period – particularly in the way he prepares prior to open-world store and bank heists.
paragraphs.cn: 在过去三周里玩过这款游戏后，我无法想象要从中移除任何东西。有趣的是，Nelson玩《GTA6》的方式似乎与我在评测期间逐渐形成的玩法极为相似——尤其是他在开放世界中抢劫商店和银行前的准备方式。

paragraphs.en: “I love just going into a store and buying a six-pack and walking down the street, drinking them one at a time, getting progressively more belligerent ’til I’m throwing the last two and talking to people,” grins Nelson. “And then I’ll call Lucia and see if she wants to hang out and sort of walk around”
paragraphs.cn: 「我喜欢走进商店买一组六罐装饮料，然后沿着街道走，一罐接一罐地喝，变得越来越好斗，直到把最后两罐扔出去，再和人们说说话，」Nelson咧嘴笑着说。「然后我会给Lucia打电话，看看她想不想一起出去，大概就是四处走走。」

paragraphs.en: “Just watching the world, the city, pass from day to night and seeing the population change and seeing people out for a night out. I think it’s that. I think it’s the fact that you can really feel like you’re embodying your version of these characters in that world. And then you could go from playing that solo to being on a date and walking around holding hands, and you can stroll down the beach or go into a nightclub and dance together, or go robbing together.”
paragraphs.cn: 「就这样看着这个世界、这座城市从白天进入夜晚，看着人群发生变化，看着人们出门享受夜生活。我想就是这样。我想关键在于，你真的能感觉到自己在那个世界里化身为你所理解的这些角色。然后你可以从独自一人转而去约会、手牵手四处走，还可以沿着海滩漫步，或者走进夜店一起跳舞，又或者一起去抢劫。」

paragraphs.en: As I discovered myself over the last few weeks, Nelson explains that the amount of preparation you want to do typically determines how successful your crime spree will be.
paragraphs.cn: 正如我自己在过去几周里发现的那样，Nelson解释说，你愿意做多少准备，通常会决定你的一连串犯罪行动有多成功。

paragraphs.en: “I like to get just all of it ready,” he says. “I’ll just get a big vehicle, a big truck that I’ve souped up that can hold six bags, and I’ll park it somewhere close by. Then I’ll go steal a motorcycle that I don’t own and park it really close to where I’m going to go rob, go in and rob it, come out, take off on the motorcycle, stash the bags in the truck, go hit some more, [and] load the truck up with bags. Then you could either send your partner to go fence it, or go fence them yourself.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我喜欢把一切都准备好，」他说。「我会弄一辆大车，一辆经过我改装、能装六个袋子的大卡车，然后把它停在附近。接着我会去偷一辆不属于我的摩托车，把它停在离我要抢劫的地方很近的位置，进去抢劫，出来后骑摩托车离开，把袋子藏进卡车，再去抢更多地方，［然后］把卡车装满袋子。之后你既可以派搭档去销赃，也可以自己去销赃。」

paragraphs.en: IGN’s GTA 6 review is live now . We also have a GTA 6 launch live blog so you don’t miss a thing.
paragraphs.cn: IGN的《GTA6》评测现已发布。我们还有《GTA6》发售实时博客，让你不会错过任何消息。
